# Global pinned conversations
会话散落在不同工作区，重要内容不好找？全局置顶把你选中的会话集中到侧边栏顶部，支持拖拽排序和清晰的插入位置提示，也可按最近更新时间自动排序。顶部放大镜可以按会话名称、工作区或消息内容搜索全部会话。会话
内容不好找？全局置顶把你选中的会话集中到侧边栏顶部，支持拖拽排序和清晰的插入位置提示，也可按最近更新时间自动排序。顶部放大镜可以按会话名称、工作区或消息内容搜索全部会话。会话完成后，小绿点提醒你查看。
A running conversation shows only the spinning ring until the row is hovered or focused; pin and arc
hive then take its place in the same slot. This illustration is a synthetic mock rendered from the p
lugin's own styling, not a screenshot of real conversations.
A standalone DSH bundle for the `sidebar.workspaces` public slot. It replaces that browsing region a
t priority -100 (this Harness version selects the lowest numeric priority); it does not modify Harne
ss files or import internal Client modules. Disable the bundle to restore the shipped browser.
## Install

Or with the Harness CLI:

Tested with DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5`. No build step or npm account is required. The package kee
ps its original `@local/global-pins` identity so existing local installations update rather than ins
ocal/global-pins` identity so existing local installations update rather than install a second copy.
## Behavior
- Pins use the existing Host workspace pin registry, shared across workspaces. Workspace membership

is never rewritten.
- Pinned rows appear once in the global section. Unpin returns a conversation to

its original workspace and preserves its saved group position.
- Last updated uses the same Client
summary `updatedAt` value as the original browser. Manual order is stored in this browser under `loc

al.global-pins.v1`.
- Drag a conversation into the pin section to pin it. Drag within a section to r
eorder and switch to manual mode. A highlighted line and dot show the insertion point above/below a
row or at the section end. Invalid or unchanged positions show no marker. Drag a pin back onto its o
wn workspace to unpin and insert at the indicated position; the ordinary unpin button still restores

the saved group position. Cross-workspace moves are rejected.
- The pinned heading's ellipsis opens
Manual / Last updated options, with a check beside the current mode. Selecting an option, leaving t

he control, or pressing Escape closes the popup. Selecting the current mode preserves its order.
- N
ew pins lead existing manual pins. Switching to recent clears saved manual layout; switching back fr

eezes the currently visible chronology, including hidden archive positions.
- Right-click a conversa
tion, or press Shift+F10 / the context-menu key while its title is focused, to open the owned action
menu: rename, fork, archive/restore, and move up/down. Arrow keys/Home/End navigate; Escape closes
and restores focus to the title, and leaving the menu dismisses it. Rows no longer carry a per-row e

llipsis button, so the trailing edge only holds real actions.
- Session rename replaces the title in
that same row. Opening the editor focuses the input with the whole title selected, so typing replac
es it directly. Enter saves; Escape cancels. Composition input does not accidentally save/cancel. Em
pty names are rejected; failed saves keep the draft for retry; pending requests cannot duplicate. Th
e input retains its native text-edit context menu. Workspace rename and Add workspace keep their sep

arate forms.
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility limits
This is a replacement browser, not a wrapper around private components. It does not preserve the nat
ive search dialog (its filter tabs, saved searches and result grouping), workspace tree mode, child-
activity/scheduled-task indicators, approval/question status badges, directory-picker dialogs, per-w
orkspace show-more watermarks, custom row slots, or stop-and-archive confirmation. Running-session a
rchive refusal is displayed; work is not stopped automatically. Workspace removal is not provided. S
aved view layout is browser-local, not synced between devices; storage events synchronize other tabs
of the same origin. Host authorization remains authoritative.
Live Client Inspect confirms the plugin owns the sidebar slot, and the user confirmed the pinned sec
tion is visible and pinning/dragging work. The agent could not independently inspect screenshots or
drive the desktop UI: the browser entry requires authentication and native accessibility permission
is unavailable. Unit tests are not a substitute for full end-to-end visual coverage.
## Development checks
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The 62 regression tests cover ordering/partition helpers, Host delegation/validation, and Browser ho
ok/event behavior using a small VM harness (38 tests). Existing sorting, drag/storage races, and unr
ead status checks remain. New checks execute the registered `apply`/slot `inject` API with scoped in
jection enforcement for both `remote` and `remote.session`; cover same-row rename, success/refusal/r
ejection/retry, pending duplicates, empty input, composition, cancellation and focus; assert the ren
ame editor's mount ref focuses then selects the whole title and keeps its identity across typing; ve
rify the running spinner markup, localization and hover/focus reveal CSS; assert rows expose no elli
psis while the right-click menu still lists every action; exercise the search overlay (debounce and
abort wiring, local-first merge order under small group headings, snippet rendering, Enter open, Esc
ape focus restore, error/empty states, a disabled content index that keeps name matches and explains
itself, archived exclusion, trigger disabled during rename); and check native icon dimensions and f
ull-row hover CSS. These are hook/event and CSS-contract tests, not actual DOM layout or desktop int
hover CSS. These are hook/event and CSS-contract tests, not actual DOM layout or desktop int [长行截断]
The bundle logo is original artwork. Row pin icons match the shipped Harness outline/filled pin path
s. No runtime dependencies or install scripts are required.
